item.title: Racing NSW To Appeal Supreme Court Decision Impacting Funding Of NSW Race Clubs

item.title: Apprentice Izzy Neale Lowers Riding Weight For WRA Championship (Dubbo Sunday)
item.description: Please note the following: DUBBO (Sunday 15th March) Race 7, No. 13 - POISEN POINT - App. I. Neale has been granted permission to ride the mare at its allotted weight of 54kg, 1kg below her minimum riding weight. App. Neale will ride at her minimum riding weight of 55kg for all other engagements.

item.title: Ballina Races Saturday Postponed
item.description: Racing NSW advises the Ballina race meeting scheduled for tomorrow, Saturday 14th March 2026 has been postponed. The track has been deemed unsuitable for racing following 65mm of rainfall since 9am this morning.
